subtitle: Review archive provenance
description: Keptora is a focused macOS workspace built around the Archive Review Studio. It helps you review, organize, verify, and export work with explicit evidence, reversible actions, and a clear audit trail. The app is designed for local-first workflows, keyboard-friendly operation, and predictable failure recovery without turning the experience into a generic dashboard.
promotional_text: A focused macOS workflow for archive review studio.
whats_new_1_0: Initial release with the complete local-first workflow, recovery safeguards, accessibility hardening, and release evidence tooling.
review_notes: Open Keptora and use the included synthetic demo/screenshot mode to exercise the main Archive Review Studio workflow without personal data. Purchase UI uses the bundled StoreKit configuration for local testing; production product identifiers are injected at release time.
